metaTitle: Custom Tri Blend Sweaters & Cardigans | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom tri blend sweaters and cardigans for your team. Soft, durable, and perfect for embroidery or screen printing. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Tri blend fabric combines cotton, polyester, and rayon for a sweater that feels soft against the skin while holding its shape through repeated wear. Unlike pure cotton or acrylic options, tri blend resists pilling and drapes comfortably, making it a strong choice for corporate uniforms or employee gifts. The fabric takes screen printing and embroidery cleanly, so your logo stays crisp. Whether you need lightweight cardigans for the office or heavier pullovers for outdoor events, tri blend offers a balanced feel that works across seasons.
heroAltText: Custom tri blend sweaters and cardigans in heather grey with embroidered logo, soft fabric texture visible
